changes.reason: 19 Oct 2026: the bingo draw, tickets, claim rule and tablet fallbacks moved into one named, versioned module; the server deals and judges; the tablet stands in only after an outage the server recorded; per-state switch.

The rule that judges it is a constant here; the server reads the venue's saved rule from vp_bingo_patterns (migration 118) by id, scoped to the draw's venue, and never takes it from the console or a phone. The seven built-in patterns are unchanged.
